# The biplane's shot: a twin pair of glowing bolts 0.12 x 0.5 m, 0.32 m apart (unlit). Pivot at the pair's centre.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Shot --base-color 0.937 0.847 0.631 --no-slot --emission 0.937 0.847 0.631
add mesh cube --name Bolt1 --size 1 --location -0.160 0.000 0.000
scale 0.120 0.500 0.120
apply --scale
select Bolt1
material assign Shot
add mesh cube --name Bolt2 --size 1 --location 0.160 0.000 0.000
scale 0.120 0.500 0.120
apply --scale
select Bolt2
material assign Shot
select all
shade flat
export shot.glb
